about: Camera moves with plain names, what each is for, and the words each model reads. higgsfield is the preset name on Higgsfield's camera controls page; still is how an image model reads the same idea. Sources: the model guides in models.json.

moves.name: Locked-off
moves.for: Let the subject do the work: demos, talking to camera, a pour or a spin.
moves.kling: static camera, no camera movement
moves.veo: a static locked-off shot
moves.runway: the locked-off camera remains perfectly still

moves.name: Push in
moves.for: Pull attention to one thing: the product, a face, a detail.
moves.kling: slow, steady dolly in toward the subject
moves.veo: a slow dolly-in shot
moves.runway: the camera slowly pushes in
moves.still: close framing, subject filling the frame

moves.name: Pull back
moves.for: Reveal: start on a detail, end on the whole scene or the finished job.
moves.kling: start on a close-up, then slowly pull back to reveal the full scene
moves.veo: a slow dolly-out shot that reveals the full scene
moves.runway: the camera slowly pulls back to reveal the scene
moves.luma: the camera pulls back slowly, revealing the scene
moves.still: wide framing with the subject small in a big scene

moves.name: Orbit
moves.for: Show every side of a product or a finished piece of work.
moves.base: camera orbits slowly around the subject
moves.kling: camera orbits slowly around the subject, smooth and stable
moves.veo: a slow 180-degree arc shot around the subject
moves.runway: the camera moves in a slow, smooth arc around the subject
moves.luma: the camera circles slowly around the subject

moves.name: Half circle
moves.for: A softer orbit for people: add depth without spinning the room.
moves.base: camera arcs slowly to the right around the subject
moves.kling: camera arcs slowly to the right around the subject
moves.veo: a slow arc shot moving right around the subject
moves.runway: the camera arcs gently to the right around the subject
moves.luma: the camera arcs gently right around the subject

moves.name: Rise up
moves.for: Open or close big: rise from the subject to the whole place.
moves.kling: camera cranes up slowly, rising above the scene
moves.veo: a high-angle crane shot rising slowly above the scene
moves.runway: the camera cranes up, rising above the scene

moves.name: Drop down
moves.for: Arrive: come down from above into the scene.
moves.kling: camera cranes down slowly into the scene
moves.veo: a crane shot descending slowly into the scene
moves.runway: the camera cranes down into the scene
moves.sora: slow crane down into the scene
moves.still: high angle, looking down at the subject

moves.name: Whip pan
moves.for: Fast change between two things: before to after, problem to fix.
moves.kling: fast whip pan to the right with motion blur
moves.veo: a fast whip pan with motion blur
moves.runway: the camera whip pans quickly to the right
moves.luma: the camera whip pans fast to the side
moves.still: dynamic angle with motion blur at the edges

moves.name: Slow pan
moves.for: Show a space or a row of things: a shop, a menu, a set of tools.
moves.kling: slow, stable pan left across the scene, no sudden motion
moves.veo: a slow pan from right to left
moves.runway: the camera pans slowly to the left

moves.name: Tilt up
moves.for: Reveal height or end on a face: shoes to smile, base to top.
moves.kling: slow tilt up from the bottom to the top of the subject
moves.veo: a slow upward tilt
moves.runway: the camera tilts up slowly

moves.name: Tilt down
moves.for: Go from the setting to the detail: sky to storefront, face to hands.
moves.kling: slow tilt down to the subject
moves.veo: a slow downward tilt
moves.runway: the camera tilts down slowly

moves.name: Side track
moves.for: Move alongside someone working or walking.
moves.base: tracking shot moving alongside the subject
moves.kling: tracking shot, camera moves sideways alongside the subject at the same pace
moves.veo: a smooth tracking shot moving alongside the subject
moves.runway: the camera tracks sideways alongside the subject

moves.name: Handheld follow
moves.for: Real and close: UGC, behind the scenes, a walk through the job.
moves.kling: handheld camera following the subject, slight natural shake
moves.veo: a handheld shot following the subject, slight natural shake
moves.runway: handheld camera, natural camera shake, following the subject
moves.luma: handheld camera follows the subject with gentle shake

moves.name: Fly-through
moves.for: A fast tour: through a shop, a house, a finished yard.
moves.kling: fast FPV drone shot flying through the space, smooth
moves.veo: an FPV drone shot flying smoothly through the space
moves.runway: the camera flies through the space like an FPV drone, smooth and fast
moves.luma: FPV drone flies through the scene
moves.still: wide-angle view down a long space

moves.name: Macro push
moves.for: Texture and detail: fabric, food, a polished surface, a stitch.
moves.base: macro lens, very slow push in on the detail
moves.kling: extreme close-up, macro lens, very slow push in on the texture
moves.veo: an extreme close-up with a macro lens, pushing in very slowly
moves.runway: extreme close-up, the camera pushes in very slowly on the texture
moves.luma: macro close-up, the camera creeps forward
moves.sora: macro extreme close-up, very slow push-in
moves.still: macro extreme close-up, shallow depth of field

moves.name: Focus pull
moves.for: Shift attention from one thing to another in the same frame.
moves.base: rack focus from foreground to background
moves.kling: rack focus, focus shifts from the foreground to the subject behind
moves.veo: a rack focus from the foreground to the subject, shallow depth of field
moves.runway: the focus shifts from the foreground to the subject
moves.luma: focus pulls from the foreground to the subject
moves.sora: rack focus from foreground to subject
moves.still: shallow depth of field, foreground softly blurred

moves.name: Snap zoom
moves.for: A punchy hook in the first second.
moves.kling: fast crash zoom in on the subject
moves.veo: a sudden fast zoom in on the subject
moves.runway: crash zoom into the subject

moves.name: Vertigo zoom
moves.for: A dramatic moment: the background stretches while the subject holds.
moves.kling: dolly zoom, the background stretches while the subject stays the same size
moves.veo: a dolly zoom, background warping while the subject stays fixed
moves.runway: dolly zoom, the background stretches as the subject stays still

moves.name: Overhead
moves.for: Flat lays, recipes, desks, tools laid out, unboxing.
moves.kling: top-down overhead shot, camera slides slowly across
moves.veo: a top-down overhead shot sliding slowly across
moves.runway: overhead shot, the camera slides slowly across

moves.name: Hero angle
moves.for: Make it look important: product on a plinth, a person after the job.
moves.base: low-angle hero shot, slow push in
moves.kling: low angle hero shot, camera pushes in slowly from below
moves.veo: a low-angle hero shot, pushing in slowly
moves.runway: low angle, the camera pushes in slowly from below
moves.luma: low-angle hero shot, slow push in

moves.name: Aerial pull-away
moves.for: End wide: from the job site up to the street or the town.
moves.base: aerial pullback rising away from the subject
moves.kling: aerial shot rising and pulling back from the subject
moves.veo: an aerial shot rising and pulling away from the subject
moves.runway: the camera rises and pulls back into an aerial view

moves.name: Through the gap
moves.for: A playful entrance: through a doorway, a window, a shelf.
moves.base: camera moves through a doorway into the scene
moves.kling: camera moves forward through a doorway into the scene
moves.veo: a shot moving forward through a doorway into the scene
moves.runway: the camera passes through a doorway into the scene
moves.luma: the camera glides through a doorway into the scene
moves.sora: camera passes through a doorway into the scene

moves.name: Point of view
moves.for: Put the viewer in the seat: using the product, doing the job.
moves.kling: first-person POV shot, hands visible in frame
moves.veo: a POV shot, hands visible in frame
moves.runway: first-person point of view, hands in frame

moves.name: Turntable spin
moves.for: The classic product spin on a clean background.
moves.base: the product turns slowly on a turntable, static camera
moves.kling: the product rotates slowly on a turntable, static camera
moves.veo: a static shot as the product rotates slowly on a turntable
moves.runway: the locked-off camera holds as the product rotates slowly on a turntable
moves.luma: the product spins slowly on a turntable, camera still
moves.sora: static camera, product rotates slowly on a turntable
moves.still: centered product on a round pedestal

moves.name: Time squeeze
moves.for: Show a long job in seconds: a clean, a build, a lawn.
moves.base: timelapse, static camera, the work happens fast
moves.kling: timelapse from a static camera, the work progresses quickly
moves.veo: a timelapse from a static camera as the work progresses quickly
moves.runway: timelapse, the locked-off camera holds while the work progresses quickly

moves.name: Frozen moment
moves.for: Freeze a splash, a toss or a jump and circle it.
moves.base: bullet time, the moment freezes as the camera circles
moves.kling: bullet time effect, the action freezes mid-air while the camera circles
moves.veo: a bullet-time shot, the action frozen mid-air as the camera circles
moves.runway: the action freezes mid-air as the camera moves in an arc around it
moves.luma: bullet time, frozen moment, camera circles
moves.still: frozen action mid-air, high shutter speed
